name: Chongwu Lianren
source:
You play as a freshman who has just entered a university known for its animal science and veterinary programs. But as you settle into campus life, you begin to realize there's something hidden beneath the surface—something that can't be explained.

As the story develops, you’ll get to know three very different characters. Each one offers a new perspective, and together, they reveal the larger mystery behind this world. 

[From [url=https://xlllida.itch.io/petting-lover]itch.io[/url]]
